meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Each quarter's figures come from the companies that reported in that quarter; growth rates compare the same companies a year apart and are final as printed.
meta.product: SDMX dataset RATIO_LNGNFC_SAL_QTR_RN (Ratios of Listed Non-Government Non-Financial Companies Quartely - Sales)
meta.coverage: Listed private non-financial companies, ratios by size of sales, quarterly
meta.note: Per cent, except interest coverage and cash coverage, which are times. Each period's ratios are for the companies that reported that period.
